name: Empathy Mapping
deliverable: Synthesized user observations across Says, Thinks, Does, and Feels

steps.text: Draw four quadrants, Says, Thinks, Does, and Feels, and pin one real user in the center.
Fill Says and Does first from observed quotes and actions, not from assumptions.
Infer Thinks and Feels from the same observations and mark each inference as a guess.
Look for contradictions between what the user says and what they actually do.
Summarize the map in two sentences: the user's goal and the tension in the way.

failure: The team fills all four quadrants from memory in one pass, so Thinks and Feels become invented inner monologue and the map flatters the product.
intervention: Ask for the quote or observed action behind each note; if there is none, move it to a to-verify corner and keep it out of the synthesis.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Widely used in design practice; no single documented originator.
